V01.root_cause: Routes built replacement lists before coordinator admission; successful compound edits could overwrite accepted concurrent changes.
V01.correction: Explicit ESPHome, Apprise and HA discovery operations apply to freshly locked authoritative values in settings persistence, then canonical validation/audit/commit and existing owned activation; safe accepted representations prepared before commit.
V01.before: Lost updates reproduced with real concurrent route entry, including separate coordinators; 16/23 baseline failures include V02 and guarded status/privacy contracts.
V01.after: All 23 API/PostgreSQL cases pass; full harness repeats suite-004.

V02.root_cause: Index-only deletion confirmation could substitute the next destination after list shifts.
V02.correction: Required opaque HMAC destination identity plus ordered-list revision bind confirmation and mutation under the same settings locks; stale binding returns 409, index-only clients 422; fresh duplicate selection removes exactly one occurrence; UI uses accepted authoritative URLs.
V02.before: Preceding deletion, reorder/duplicate and concurrency regressions fail on captured starting application.
V02.after: All 23 API/PostgreSQL and affected58 browser checks pass.
